survey: A blue arched wooden door, seen straight on. It sits inside an orange wooden arched frame set into a cream plaster wall, with ivy over the top and down both sides. The door face is flat to the camera. Its vertical planks run straight up and down, and the lower recessed panel and its rails are level rectangles, square to the door edges. The flower wreath with an orange bow hangs flat against the upper door. A brass knob on a vertical backplate sits on the right side; the knob is seen face-on, as it should be on a frontal door. Two hinges on the left edge face the camera. The frame's jambs stand vertical on rectangular plinth blocks whose fronts face the camera. The stone threshold and paving below are seen from slightly above, so their top faces show as thin bands. That fits a camera at about door-handle height looking level at the door. The door bottom, the plinths and the frame all meet the paving along one horizontal line. Verticals stay vertical, horizontals stay level, and the arch is symmetric. Everything agrees on one frontal viewpoint.
